column1: # Three fields a line, a TAB between them: section, key, value. Lines beginning with # are skipped.
#   meta   what language this is (code, codes, name, game = the word in Skyrim.ini's sLanguage, script)
#   time   words of time. The key is English as the time reader knows it; the value is every form, | between them.
#   place  words of place ("home", "outside", "upstairs"): the same way.
#   free   little words that stand beside a name and are no part of it (articles, prepositions).
#   label  what the player reads: the English sentence with {1} {2} for names, then the same in this language.
#          Copy the lines you want to translate from _labels_template.tsv.
# Longer forms win over shorter ones, so "morgen früh" may stand beside "morgen".
